# Agent-Safe Bible

Public-domain Scripture corpus and agent contract.
https://github.com/ChristFollower873461/agent-safe-bible

Read AGENTS.md first. Default translation: BSB. Allowed: BSB, WEB, KJV. Refused: NIV, ESV, NASB, NLT, CSB, NKJV, and any other limited-license edition.

Quote only from this corpus. Never quote from memory. Never paraphrase as Scripture. Fail closed on unknown references.

v0 status: planning. Fixtures exist for John 3:16. Full 66-book ingest is not done.

Key files:
- AGENTS.md
- PLAN.md
- data/allowlist.json
- schemas/passage.v1.schema.json
- skills/scripture-quote/SKILL.md
- data/fixtures/
